caseNameFull: Robert E. O'CONNOR, et ux. v. UNITED STATES Paul H. COPLIN, et ux. v. UNITED STATES Jack R. MATTOX, et ux. v. UNITED STATES

opinions.text: Petitions for writs of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit granted. The cases are consolidated and a total of one hour is allotted for oral argument.
